zh-CN.title: 小程序顶部操作更清晰
items: 聊天、通讯、广场和菜单现在都在微信胶囊左侧提供一致的主操作
广场通知、额度与搜索已移至子页签右侧，投稿时会切换为新建投稿

en.title: Clearer mini program header actions
items: Chat, Contacts, Square, and Menu now share one consistent primary action beside the WeChat capsule
Square notifications, quota, and search now sit beside the subtabs, while Submissions switches to a dedicated create action
